title: auth.email.requested (schema_version 1)
description: Published by the auth service's account module via the outbox (D-009) whenever a transactional email needs to be sent (email verification, password reset). Partition key = accountUuid. Consumed by the Notification Service, which has no other channel to obtain the raw token.

accountUuid.description: External account identifier — the same value used as the JWT 'sub' claim.

purpose.description: What the email is for. Known values today: verify_email, password_reset. Deliberately not a closed enum — this is an open, string-typed reason code, not a fixed set (the payload's own Javadoc: 'later password_reset', i.e. open to more values over time).

token.description: The raw verification/reset token, in the clear. A deliberate, documented exception to the standing rule that a credential appears exactly once in a creation response — the Notification Service has no other channel to obtain it.
